blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA — At 41 years old and still playing at an elite level, some might say LeBron James is aging like a fine wine. Well, maybe having some wine during Monday’s contest helped his game, too. After coming up empty on a fastbreak, James crashed into a Philadelphia 76ers fan behind the basket and took a a sip of the fan’s wine during Philadelphia’s 126-107 win over the Chicago Bulls on Monday night. “I crashed into him, spilled some of his wine,” James said after posting 15 points, nine assists, and seven rebounds. “So I wanted to see if it was […]...
